title: pack-check timed, and faster
text: pack-check records how long each stage takes and checks the shipped and the repaired pack side by side.
result: pack-check times every stage (read, static checks, each server start) and starts the repaired pack's server beside the shipped one. On Prehistoric World 2 (368 mods) a full check with the repair proven takes 5.1 minutes instead of 12.7, with the same findings. Client-only mods a start finds are remembered, so later runs skip that extra start; a start that only reads the world stops as soon as its probe is done; Simple Voice Chat gets a free port so the two servers do not collide, and a start that still loses a port runs again alone; a server that stops before its probe is done is reported at once instead of after the 20-minute timeout; an export is unpacked once. Tried for the 4.0-minute target and not used: the lighter compiler (C1) cuts a 368-mod server start's CPU by a third (519 to 351 CPU-s) but made the start take 465 s instead of 139 s; the item probe already uses 40 ms of every 50 ms server tick. The 4.0-minute target was dropped on Nov 7; the time stays as a fact.
